title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
description: Footage shows Vladimir Putin greeting Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, before saying the current situation "is not so easy".

title: Disruption at Port of Dover as masked 'stop the boats' protesters block roads
description: The government says it condemns "the behaviour in Dover" and the hours-long disruption it caused.

title: Nigel Farage tells BBC he 'wasn't listening' during foreign donor talks filmed undercover
description: The Reform leader also told the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg that his family are "begging" him to leave his job.

title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
description: Iran's state media reported that Tehran has launched retaliatory attacks against three US-affiliated vessels; the US is yet to comment.

title: Jaguar Land Rover confirms planned job cuts
description: The firm says it needs to save about £1.7bn over the next two years.

title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
description: The Prince of Wales will represent the King at the funeral of Harald V in Oslo next week.

title: Major disruption as grass fire halts all trains to Heathrow Airport
description: Severe delays and cancellations are set to continue, with no trains between central London and the airport.

title: Chris Mason: Reform UK winded by donations row as insiders call for shift in approach
description: Nigel Farage's admirers in the party are calling for a stronger operation as the party aims for power.

title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
